speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are experiencing agitation, have a yellowish tint to your skin and eyes, and have abnormal lab results. To understand the cause of your jaundice, how long have these symptoms been present, and have you noticed any pain in your upper right abdomen or changes in your urine or stool color?

speaker: Patient
text: 20-year-old male. The patient was previously healthy and has been brought to the emergency department due to agitation over the past 24 hours. Family members have noticed a yellowish coloring of his skin and eyes over the past week. The patient has a history of occasional cocaine and ecstasy use, and drinks alcohol socially on weekends. The patient also admits to high-risk sexual behaviors without using appropriate protection.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Hepatitis (likely viral or drug-induced).

REQUEST TEST: Liver function panel (AST, ALT, Bilirubin, Alkaline Phosphatase, PT/INR), HIV antigen/antibody, Hepatitis B surface antigen, Hepatitis C antibody. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal ultrasound.
